concern_results.conclusion: base_derived_candidate is a faithful extraction of the old --base path and is shared by freeze_packet and the binder's --print-candidate, so one hash implementation serves both sides; the combined mode anchors packet.startswith(candidate), derives candidate_paths and candidate_bytes from the candidate, and all 6-tuple call sites (main, race probe, binder candidate_hash) were updated; the prior-round loop rename prevents shadowing the new candidate_hash parameter, so material_candidate_change now compares the last prior candidate against the current one.

the reviewer-saw-it property survives the equality removal: prefix containment refuses truncated, interleaved, prepended-decoy, and unrelated packets (the bare-containment decoy bypass is closed and tested), an empty base-derived candidate is refused rather than trivially contained, the egress secret scan still covers the whole widened packet, and the wording-only proof is refused only in the combined form where its scope would be ambiguous.

every refusal carries an actionable message (BEGIN/append guidance, --paths requires --base, wording-only combined refusal, empty_diff reason codes), invalid base and non-repo cwd still raise GateError, and the SKILL.md round-pair check still hard-fails when round 2 binds a different candidate.

the new gate probe asserts the acceptance shapes end-to-end (hash split on widening, truncation/interleave/prepend/unrelated refused, diff-file-alone unchanged, wording-only combined refused while bare stays accepted, empty candidate refused, paths from candidate, candidate_bytes boundary), and the cross-side binder case derives base/paths from candidate_scope and asserts the controller-recorded identity equals the gate-recomputed one; the recorded mutation rows, including the honest non-discriminating binder mutation, match the assertions present in the diff.

with no --diff-file the packet is the candidate so both hashes keep today's value, --diff-file alone keeps today's meaning, pre-existing receipts remain valid because their packet equaled their candidate, and the profile gains only the additive candidate_bytes field with no receipt schema break.

the 0.16.0 bump lands in package.json and both lockfile sites matching the release-version check, nothing migrates, receipts written before this change keep their meaning, and reverting restores prior behavior without invalidating any receipt.

the receipt records packet_sha256 and candidate_sha256 separately, the profile carries candidate_bytes plus an explicit trust-boundary sentence telling the reviewer exactly which bytes land, refusal messages name the corrective action, and SKILL.md plus staged-review-contract.md document the composition rules including keeping the packet file outside the repository.

the merge-readiness gate cannot accept a packet that drops, splices, or front-runs candidate bytes, the accept set widens only to packets provably beginning with the full base-derived candidate, chain succession and completion checkpoints now bind candidate-to-candidate so no evidence class is dropped, and the binder recomputes through the same freeze implementation so the two sides cannot drift into two definitions of the identity.
